title: Versioned notification digest wakeups
summary:
Перевести notification digest bridge на versioned wakeup definition и
доказать exact-version/legacy behavior без изменения digest semantics.
why:
`@plan/knowledge/research-P11-design.json` §11.2; D59. Notifications — второй реальный
wakeup producer/handler; без него contract suite доказывает только
tasks-workflow case.

include:
Structured handler declaration `notification-digest/1`; stamped scheduling;
adapter compatibility; explicit bounded legacy fixture; mismatch/no-invocation tests.
exclude:
Digest selection/delivery policy; notification DDL; channel drivers; generic
wakeup mechanics; enabling legacy admission by default in production.

rules:
Canonical kind remains `notification.digest.v1`; implementation version
is `notification-digest/1`. New rows are always stamped. Legacy admission is test/config explicit,
bounded to this definition and false by default. Version mismatch/missing stamp never reaches the
adapter; existing digest idempotency/concurrency semantics stay unchanged.
guidance:
Reuse P11.5 config shape; do not add a notifications-side registry or duplicate
stamp serializer. Assert the adapter receives the same unwrapped payload DTO as before.
deliverables:
Stamped digest scheduling, versioned handler declaration and compatibility/mismatch
proof for the second wakeup consumer.

result.notes:
P11.7 GREEN: notification-digest/1 stamp, default-denied legacy, explicit opt-in, mismatch quarantine. pest 19/73, pg 2/2, phpstan 0, pint ok.
